scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @apple/contracts build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n contracts,api,web "pnpm --filter @apple/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @apple/api dev" "pnpm --filter @apple/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @apple/contracts build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && pnpm typecheck:worker
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @apple/contracts build && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:worker
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm assets:check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm perf:build
